query_analysis.original_query: The liquid level in our three-phase separator is fluctuating, causing downstream instability. How can we diagnose and resolve this issue?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the root causes of liquid level fluctuations in a three-phase separator and develop a solution to stabilize the system and mitigate downstream process impacts.

selected_agents.role: Root cause analysis and solution development
Level control system evaluation and optimization

communication_strategy.information_flow: Diagnostic data sharing and solution iteration

clarification_questions: What is the typical operating range for the liquid level in the separator?
Have there been any recent changes in feed composition or flow rates?
What type of level control system is currently in place?
